function.description:
This API retrieves a list of **Catalyst Center controller-side** scheduled maintenance windows for managed network devices — start/end IDs tied to DNAC Activities. It answers "which maintenance blackout did I schedule in Catalyst Center?" workflows.

**NOT FOR** IOS-XE / NX-OS **device-local switch port schedules** (EEM applets / Kron schedules / nightly port shutdown macros). Those device-CLI schedules never appear here.

Use '/dna/intent/api/v1/networkDeviceMaintenanceSchedules/count' API to get the total record count. For datasets over the page limit, page with offset.
function.name: api_retrieveScheduledMaintenanceWindowsForNetworkDevices

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

order.description: Whether ascending or descending order should be used to sort the response.

sortBy.description: A property within the response to sort by.

status.description: The status of the maintenance schedule. Possible values are: UPCOMING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, FAILED. Refer features for more details.

description.description: A brief narrative describing the maintenance schedule.

id.description: Id of the schedule maintenance window

maintenanceSchedule.description: Contains all the details necessary to define the maintenance window and its recurrence.

endId.description: Activity id of end schedule of the maintenance window. To check the status of the end schedule, use GET /dna/intent/api/v1/activities/{id}. endId remains same for every occurrence of recurrence instance.

endTime.description: End time indicates the ending of the maintenance window in Unix epoch time in milliseconds.

recurrence.description: Details about the recurrence of the maintenance schedule

interval.description: Interval for recurrence in days. The interval must be longer than the duration of the schedules. The maximum allowed interval is 365 days.

recurrenceEndTime.description: The end date for the recurrence in Unix epoch time in milliseconds. Recurrence end time should be greater than maintenance end date/time.

startId.description: Activity id of start schedule of the maintenance window. To check the status of the start schedule, use GET /dna/intent/api/v1/activities/{id}. startId remains same for every occurrence of recurrence instance.

startTime.description: Start time indicates the beginning of the maintenance window in Unix epoch time in milliseconds.

status.description: The status of the maintenance schedule.

networkDeviceIds.description: List of network device ids. This field is applicable only during creation of schedules; for updates, it is read-only.
